description: The February export repeats the last 25 calls of January, so stacking the two files counts them twice.
expected: January and February are stacked into one table of 150 calls, each call once.

checks.label: 150 calls once each after stacking the two exports

person.if_fails: The person would have to tick the plan's suggestion "Stack <file> and <file> into one table". It is shown but not pre-ticked, so each file is used alone and the other one's customers are not counted. The product should PRE-TICK it, not ask: the files have the same columns, it has already measured the repeated rows, and the suggestion states the rows before and after; the approval still names it and one click unticks it.
